task: Write a Python function normalize_phone(s) that strips everything except digits from a phone number string and returns None if fewer than 10 digits remain.
solution_criteria: Removes all non-digit characters; returns None when fewer than 10 digits remain; returns the digit string otherwise; uses only the standard library.

task: Give a regular expression that matches dates in YYYY-MM-DD format where the month is 01-12 and the day is 01-31.
solution_criteria: Matches four-digit years; restricts months to 01-12; restricts days to 01-31; does not match partial strings like 2024-13-01.

task: Produce a JSON object that maps each of these messy country values to an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code: 'U.S.A.', 'united kingdom', 'Deutschland', 'españa'.
solution_criteria: Valid JSON object; keys are the original strings exactly; values are US, GB, DE and ES.
